items.User: I don't want you to actually build the app, just to document how it works so I can refine a plan.

Agent.text: Person wants plan docs, not a build. Writing documentation into app/, stopping code work.

I stopped building and wrote the plan as five documents in the project folder instead. They cover how the editor works screen by screen, how each Markdown formatting tool behaves, the preview, reading code with colours, the full list of keyboard shortcuts, how it would run on Windows, macOS and Linux, a suggested build order in stages, and 14 open questions for you to decide.

As you asked, I didn't build or test it, so a few early unfinished pieces of code are still in the folder. They're marked as drafts in the documents and you can keep or drop them. I had no picture of the original, so its exact colours and spacing are a guess; you could add a screenshot of the look you want, or start by answering the open questions in the build-order document.
